title: Halal
subtitle: No prohibited or undeclared ingredients were found on this label.
description: Halal is not something BOTIA finds. It is what remains when nothing forbidden or unexplained appears.
why_body: Under Islamic Law, food must not contain anything unlawful, and must not have been in contact with non-halal substances during preparation. BOTIA reads what the label declares. When no forbidden ingredient appears and no origin is left undeclared, there is nothing on that label to flag.
what_body: Nothing. No haram ingredient was declared, and no ingredient was found whose origin the label failed to explain. That absence is the result — not a certification.
can_1: Read every ingredient declared on the label.
can_2: Confirm that no clearly haram ingredient appears among them.
can_3: Confirm that no declared ingredient was left with an undisclosed origin.
cannot_1: Certify Halal — it is not a certification body.
cannot_2: Know the slaughter method or the conditions of the facility.
cannot_3: See anything the label does not declare.
closing: Nothing was flagged. That is what the label says — and BOTIA reads nothing more than the label.
